project_title: DataVerse 2K27 - College Technical & Data Science Event

event_details.organizer: Department of Basic Science and Humanities, IEM Kolkata, in association with Society for Data Science, IEM Student Chapter

design_archetype.name: ELECTRIC NEON & CYBER DATA ARCHITECTURE
design_archetype.vibe: Futuristic AI, high-tech data core, dark obsidian space, electric neon cyan laser beams, deep amethyst glowing nodes, and regal gold triumphs.
design_archetype.theme_mode: Dark mode primary with deep navy/black, glowing neon accents, glassmorphic HUD overlays.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none

layout_and_grid.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-6 md:gap-8

visual_enhancers.gold_badge: bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500/20 to-yellow-500/10 border border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300
visual_enhancers.gradient_text: bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 via-purple-400 to-amber-300 bg-clip-text text-transparent

pages_and_components.navigation: Sticky nav with logo, live countdown mini badge, navigation links (Home, About, Events, Schedule, Rules, Sponsors, Gallery, FAQ, Admin), and 'Register Now' primary button.
pages_and_components.hero_section: Futuristic AI matrix grid animation background, DataVerse 2K27 brand banner, tagline, countdown timer (Days:Hours:Mins:Secs), live registration status, CTA buttons to Register or View Events.
pages_and_components.about_section: Interactive breakdown of IEM Kolkata, BSH Dept, SDS Student Chapter, event mission, key highlights counter (6+ Events, 1000+ Participants, ₹50,000+ Prize Pool).
pages_and_components.event_categories: Interactive card showcase for 6 core events: Ideaforge (Hackathon/Idea Pitching), Poster Presentation, Data Treasure Hunt, Games Carnival, Workshops, Grand Auction. Cards include eligibility, prize info, time slots, and 'Select Event' action.
pages_and_components.schedule_timeline: Day 1 (13 Feb) & Day 2 (14 Feb) interactive tabbed timeline with time slots, event titles, venues within IEM campus, speaker/judge tags.
pages_and_components.registration_flow: 3-step wizard: Step 1 (Select Tier: Single ₹350, Double ₹399, All Access ₹449 & pick events), Step 2 (Participant Info: Name, Email, Phone, College, Roll/ID, Year, Department), Step 3 (Payment: Google Pay QR code display, UPI Txn ID input, screenshot upload, terms acceptance). On submit -> generates Unique Registration ID (DV27-XXXX) and digital QR ticket preview.
pages_and_components.ticket_page: Participant Pass verification screen with downloadable PDF/PNG ticket design, scanned QR code payload, venue map, rules checklist, and print option.
pages_and_components.admin_dashboard: Single admin secure login (Passcode/Credentials), verification stats summary (Total Registrations, Pending Approvals, Verified Revenue, Event-wise breakdown), Search & Filter table, UPI screenshot verification modal, Approve/Reject status toggle, and CSV/Excel export button.
pages_and_components.rules_guidelines: Accordion and tabbed list of general decorum, submission rules, judging criteria, code of conduct.
pages_and_components.sponsors_partners: Sponsor grid featuring title sponsors, co-sponsors, community partners with sleek glow hover states.
pages_and_components.organizing_team: Grid of student leads, faculty coordinators, department heads with LinkedIn/Social badges.
pages_and_components.gallery: Masonry/grid preview of past data science hackathons, IEM campus, trophy celebrations.
pages_and_components.faqs_and_contact: Expandable FAQ accordion + quick contact form + IEM Kolkata Google Map embed + Instagram @dataverse.2k27 feed banner.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the fonts (Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, JetBrains Mono) are loaded in public/index.html or imported in index.css.
Use mock local storage / mock backend API store so registration registrations persist across page refreshes and admin dashboard operations.
Support single admin login state (stored in localStorage or React context). Admin credentials default e.g. admin@dataverse2k27.in / dataverse2027.
For QR Code generation on participant tickets, render a real downloadable SVG/Canvas QR using qrcode.react or canvas/SVG elements.

Ensure all buttons, form fields, inputs, cards, filter dropdowns, tabs, and interactive triggers have clear data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='register-now-btn', data-testid='event-card-ideaforge', data-testid='admin-login-submit').
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for navigation headers, modals, or dropdowns. Always use solid or frosted dark glassmorphic backgrounds (bg-slate-950/90 or bg-slate-900/95).
Implement Sonner toast notifications for feedback when copying ticket IDs, submitting registration, uploading receipts, and admin verification actions.
Ensure full mobile, tablet, and desktop responsiveness with mobile hamburger menu drawer for smooth navigation.
